aboutTitle: What does the Word Counter measure?
about: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you edit your text. The tool also provides reading and speaking time estimates to help you plan content length.
example: Enter "Write clear and useful content." to check a five-word sentence. Add another paragraph to see how the counts change.

faqs.question: Are reading and speaking times exact?
faqs.answer: They are estimates. Actual time varies with the reader, delivery speed and complexity of the text.

faqs.question: Why might another editor show a different count?
faqs.answer: Tools can count punctuation, hyphenated words and whitespace differently. Use the counting method required by your publisher when a strict limit applies.
